verbatim: Ruling for the case the CSS-width cut is nondetermining, so you are not blocked later. Handover mechanism: after the capture sequence releases the machine, stop each old partition at a start boundary (immediately after its current start writes its final checkpoint), transfer every index it has not completed to the reviewed exact-once claim scheduler, and if a start was already in progress when the process stopped, the scheduler reruns that index from its original seed vector with the aborted partial retained under an 'aborted' label and never scored. Fits are deterministic per seed, so a rerun is the same execution and not a duplicate result; nothing completed is rerun and no completed checkpoint is discarded. Record each stop with the partition, the boundary index and the time. This is an execution-mechanism change only: no budget, box, tolerance, seed or model changes. The same mechanism applies when the CSS certificate lands, in addition to the certified stop.
